description: Headline figures from a UK company's latest filed accounts at Companies House: net assets, cash, debtors, creditors, employees and, where published, turnover and profit, with the prior year for comparison. Works for most small and medium companies that file digital accounts; large companies and groups usually file PDF only, and then the tool says so and links the filing. Use for supplier and credit checks: is it solvent, how much cash, is it growing. (cost: 3 credits)
name: company_accounts
